title: Excellent and great location – Mrs G Dundee

post.title: Excellent and great location – Mrs G Dundee
post.html: Stayed here for 2 nights as husband had a course nearby and we chose this for convenience. The property is dog friendly and lots of grounds to explore. Cottage is perfect for needs, basic but more than ample… Also very reasonable price. Great location for nearby towns and local pubs….would recommend The Sun Inn in Everton.. Excellent pub food and very reasonable. We will definitely return in the future and would like to stay longer.

description: A guest review of a dog-friendly stay at Blaco Hill Farm Cottages, with grounds to explore and a handy base for nearby towns.
